verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you O house of Israel

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אַל־ תִּלְמָ֔דוּ וּמֵאֹת֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אַל־ תֵּחָ֑תּוּ כִּֽי־ יֵחַ֥תּוּ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מֵהֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- de·reḵ hag·gō·w·yim ’al- til·mā·ḏū ū·mê·’ō·ṯō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim ’al- tê·ḥāt·tū kî- yê·ḥat·tū hag·gō·w·yim mê·hêm·māh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD . . . says Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens . . . though the nations themselves are terrified by them

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חֻקּ֥וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֖ים הֶ֣בֶל ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ עֵץ֙ מִיַּ֣עַר כְּרָת֔וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵ֥י־ חָרָ֖שׁ בַּֽמַּעֲצָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥuq·qō·wṯ hā·‘am·mîm he·ḇel hū kî- ‘êṣ mî·ya·‘ar kə·rā·ṯōw ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê- ḥā·rāš bam·ma·‘ă·ṣāḏ
verses.literal: For the customs of the peoples are worthless . . . . . . they cut down a tree from the forest it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman

verses.original: בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב יְיַפֵּ֑הוּ בְּמַסְמְר֧וֹת וּבְמַקָּב֛וֹת יְחַזְּק֖וּם וְל֥וֹא יָפִֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḇə·zā·hāḇ yə·yap·pê·hū bə·mas·mə·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·maq·qā·ḇō·wṯ yə·ḥaz·zə·qūm wə·lō·w yā·p̄îq
verses.literal: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails so that it will not totter

verses.original: כְּתֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְגַם־ הֵיטֵ֖יב אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯō·mer miq·šāh hêm·māh wə·lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū nā·śō·w yin·nā·śū kî lō yiṣ·‘ā·ḏū ’al- tî·rə·’ū mê·hem kî- lō yā·rê·‘ū wə·ḡam- hê·ṭêḇ ’ên ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch their idols cannot speak They must be carried . . . because they cannot walk Do not fear them for they can do no harm and neither can they . . . do any good

verses.original: מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹךָ יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל אַתָּ֛ה וְגָד֥וֹל שִׁמְךָ֖ בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā Yah·weh gā·ḏō·wl ’at·tāh wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl šim·ḵā biḡ·ḇū·rāh
verses.literal: There is none like You O LORD You are great and Your name is mighty in power

verses.original: מִ֣י לֹ֤א יִֽרָאֲךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֥י לְךָ֖ יָאָ֑תָה כִּ֣י בְכָל־ חַכְמֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם וּבְכָל־ מַלְכוּתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mî lō yi·rā·’ă·ḵā me·leḵ hag·gō·w·yim kî lə·ḵā yā·’ā·ṯāh kî ḇə·ḵāl- ḥaḵ·mê hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯām mê·’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Who would not fear You O King of nations This is Your due For among all the wise men of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like You

verses.original: וּבְאַחַ֖ת יִבְעֲר֣וּ וְיִכְסָ֑לוּ מוּסַ֥ר הֲבָלִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’a·ḥaṯ yiḇ·‘ă·rū wə·yiḵ·sā·lū mū·sar hă·ḇā·lîm ‘êṣ hū
verses.literal: But they are altogether senseless and foolish instructed by worthless idols made of wood . . .

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף מְרֻקָּ֞ע מִתַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ יוּבָ֗א וְזָהָב֙ מֵֽאוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ לְבוּשָׁ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ke·sep̄ mə·ruq·qā‘ mit·tar·šîš yū·ḇā wə·zā·hāḇ mê·’ū·p̄āz ma·‘ă·śêh ḥā·rāš wî·ḏê ṣō·w·rêp̄ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān lə·ḇū·šām ma·‘ă·śêh ḥă·ḵā·mîm kul·lām
verses.literal: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith Their clothes are blue and purple all fashioned by skilled workers

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ אֱמֶ֔ת הֽוּא־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּ֖ים וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עוֹלָ֑ם מִקִּצְפּוֹ֙ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ יָכִ֥לוּ גוֹיִ֖ם זַעְמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·meṯ hū- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay·yîm ū·me·leḵ ‘ō·w·lām miq·qiṣ·pōw tir·‘aš hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō- yā·ḵi·lū ḡō·w·yim za‘·mōw
verses.literal: But the LORD is the true God He is the living God and eternal King The earth quakes at His wrath and the nations cannot endure His indignation

verses.original: כִּדְנָה֙ תֵּאמְר֣וּן לְה֔וֹם אֱלָ֣הַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ שְׁמַיָּ֥א וְאַרְקָ֖א לָ֣א עֲבַ֑דוּ יֵאבַ֧דוּ מֵֽאַרְעָ֛א וּמִן־ תְּח֥וֹת שְׁמַיָּ֖א אֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kiḏ·nāh tê·mə·rūn lə·hō·wm ’ĕ·lā·hay·yā dî- šə·may·yā wə·’ar·qā lā ‘ă·ḇa·ḏū yê·ḇa·ḏū mê·’ar·‘ā ū·min- tə·ḥō·wṯ šə·may·yā ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Thus you are to tell them These gods who have made neither the heavens nor the earth will perish from this earth and from under these heavens

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ’e·reṣ bə·ḵō·ḥōw mê·ḵîn tê·ḇêl bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw nā·ṭāh šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: The LORD made the earth by His power He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding

verses.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִקְצֵ֣ה אֶרֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·wl tit·tōw hă·mō·wn ma·yim baš·šā·ma·yim way·ya·‘ă·leh nə·śi·’îm miq·ṣêh ʾɛ·rɛṣ bə·rā·qîm lam·mā·ṭār ‘ā·śāh way·yō·w·ṣê rū·aḥ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāw
verses.literal: When He thunders . . . the waters in the heavens roar He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses

verses.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל־ אָדָם֙ מִדַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל־ צוֹרֵ֖ף מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·‘ar kāl- ’ā·ḏām mid·da·‘aṯ hō·ḇîš kāl- ṣō·w·rêp̄ mip·pā·sel kî še·qer nis·kōw wə·lō- rū·aḥ bām
verses.literal: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols For his molten images are a fraud and there is no breath in them

verses.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: he·ḇel hêm·māh ma·‘ă·śêh ta‘·tu·‘îm bə·‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: They are worthless a work to be mocked In the time of their punishment they will perish

verses.original: לֹֽא־ כְאֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּֽי־ יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵə·’êl·leh ḥê·leq ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî- yō·w·ṣêr hak·kōl hū wə·yiś·rā·’êl šê·ḇeṭ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: The Portion of Jacob is not like these for He is the Maker of all things and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance the LORD of Hosts is His name

verses.original: אִסְפִּ֥י מֵאֶ֖רֶץ כִּנְעָתֵ֑ךְ יֹשַׁבְתִּי בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’is·pî mê·’e·reṣ kin·‘ā·ṯêḵ yō·šaḇ·tī bam·mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Gather up your belongings from this land you who live under siege

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י קוֹלֵ֛עַ אֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַזֹּ֑את וַהֲצֵר֥וֹתִי לָהֶ֖ם לְמַ֥עַן יִמְצָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî qō·w·lê·a‘ ’eṯ- yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ bap·pa·‘am haz·zōṯ wa·hă·ṣê·rō·w·ṯî lā·hem lə·ma·‘an yim·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Behold at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured

verses.original: א֥וֹי לִי֙ עַל־ שִׁבְרִ֔י נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתִ֑י וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַ֛ךְ זֶ֥ה חֳלִ֖י וְאֶשָּׂאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lî ‘al- šiḇ·rî naḥ·lāh mak·kā·ṯî wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’aḵ zeh ḥo·lî wə·’eś·śā·’en·nū
verses.literal: Woe to me because of my brokenness my wound is grievous But I said . . . This is truly my sickness and I must bear it

verses.original: אָהֳלִ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔ד וְכָל־ מֵיתָרַ֖י נִתָּ֑קוּ בָּנַ֤י יְצָאֻ֙נִי֙ וְאֵינָ֔ם אֵין־ נֹטֶ֥ה עוֹד֙ אָהֳלִ֔י וּמֵקִ֖ים יְרִיעוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ho·lî šud·dāḏ wə·ḵāl mê·ṯā·ray nit·tā·qū bā·nay yə·ṣā·’u·nî wə·’ê·nām ’ên- nō·ṭeh ‘ō·wḏ ’ā·ho·lî ū·mê·qîm yə·rî·‘ō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: My tent is destroyed and all its ropes are snapped My sons have departed from me and are no more I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains

verses.original: כִּ֤י נִבְעֲרוּ֙ הָֽרֹעִ֔ים וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א דָרָ֑שׁוּ עַל־ כֵּן֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ מַרְעִיתָ֖ם נָפֽוֹצָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî niḇ·‘ă·rū hā·rō·‘îm wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh lō ḏā·rā·šū ‘al- kên lō hiś·kî·lū wə·ḵāl mar·‘î·ṯām nā·p̄ō·w·ṣāh
verses.literal: For the shepherds have become senseless they do not seek the LORD Therefore . . . they have not prospered and all their flock is scattered

verses.original: ק֤וֹל שְׁמוּעָה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְרַ֥עַשׁ גָּד֖וֹל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: qō·wl šə·mū·‘āh hin·nêh ḇā·’āh wə·ra·‘aš gā·ḏō·wl mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn lā·śūm ’eṯ- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh šə·mā·māh mə·‘ō·wn tan·nîm
verses.literal: Listen The sound of a report is coming a great commotion from the land to the north It will make the cities of Judah a desolation a haunt for jackals

verses.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָאָדָ֖ם דַּרְכּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־ לְאִ֣ישׁ הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְהָכִ֖ין אֶֽת־ צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tî Yah·weh kî lō lā·’ā·ḏām dar·kōw lō- lə·’îš hō·lêḵ wə·hā·ḵîn ’eṯ- ṣa·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: I know O LORD that a man’s way is not his own no one who walks directs his own steps

verses.original: יַסְּרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ־ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל־ בְּאַפְּךָ֖ פֶּן־ תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yas·sə·rê·nî Yah·weh ’aḵ- bə·miš·pāṭ ’al- bə·’ap·pə·ḵā pen- tam·‘i·ṭê·nî
verses.literal: Correct me O LORD but only with justice — not in Your anger or You will bring me to nothing

verses.original: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּךָ וְעַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּשִׁמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ כִּֽי־ אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַאֲכָלֻ֙הוּ֙ וַיְכַלֻּ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ נָוֵ֖הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: šə·p̄ōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏā·‘ū·ḵā wə·‘al miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·šim·ḵā lō qā·rā·’ū kî- ’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wa·’ă·ḵā·lu·hū way·ḵal·lu·hū wə·’eṯ- nā·wê·hū hê·šam·mū
verses.literal: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You and on the families that do not call on Your name For they have devoured Jacob they have consumed him and finished him off they have devastated his homeland
